Aloo Paratha

6 parathas

Source: Original home-style example

Dough

Dough - Aloo Paratha
2 cups (240 g) whole wheat flour (atta)mix knead 8 min.rest 15 min.
1/2 tsp (3 g) salt 
1 tbsp (15 mL) oil add oil and water
about 3/4 cup (180 mL) water, as needed 

Filling

Filling - Aloo Paratha
3 medium (450 g) potatoesboil and mash mix
1 tbsp (15 mL) oil heat 
1 tsp (3 g) cumin seeds temper 
1 medium (100 g) onion, finely chopped saute until soft
2 green chillies, minced 
1 tsp (2 g) amchur (dry mango powder) 
1/2 tsp (3 g) salt 
1/4 cup (15 g) coriander leaves, chopped 

Assembly

Assembly - Aloo Paratha
1 portion prepared doughstuffrollbrushcook 2 min. per side
1 portion potato filling
1 tsp (5 mL) ghee 

Notes

  • Cook the parathas one at a time; keep the finished ones warm in a covered bowl.
